audience_and_distribution.required_before_nonfixture_narration: Concise learner/learning promise, misconception and original contribution, meaningful accurate scene sequence and independent compositions; one truthful title per format. Growth administration and experiments are optional.
audience_and_distribution.outcomes: Click appeal, learning, subscriptions and revenue remain unproven until real observations; no universal CTR/retention promises
audience_and_distribution.policy: Check applicable current rules at actual delivery. No arbitrary seven-day calendar gate or unrelated analytics/monetization research for routine publication.

viewer_experience.required_scene_coverage: Every real scene has a viewer question, meaningful visible answer, new understanding, next-scene bridge and separately composed reading/staging/caption plan
viewer_experience.early_payoff: A visible first-frame subject and scene-relative planned payoff, checked against actual timing and final frames; no universal seconds or guaranteed retention
viewer_experience.learning: Final real listening/AV and critical explanations remain primary; independent participants/card-choice studies are optional unless explicitly requested.
viewer_experience.evidence: Genuine uncoached card choices, comprehension and observed analytics; never global top-viewer personas or simulations as data
viewer_experience.topic_scope: Planning and quality criteria are topic-agnostic; new subjects need researched/tested models and rendering capability before production
viewer_experience.continuous_relationship: Honest series/next lesson, sustainable capacity-based cadence, actual viewer-led topic selection; no automatic scheduling or earnings claims

release_policy.known_defects: Carry until explicitly resolved; pending research is unknown, never PASS
release_policy.verification: Quick preflight and changed-area tests by default; --full when justified by changes
release_policy.performance: Invocation-only guarded hash reuse, one full A/V decode per verification; no cross-artifact approval reuse
